summary: Map where an arm can reach and mark the configurations where it loses a direction of motion.
objective: Build the authored planar 2R arm with its exact reachable annulus, analytical singular configurations and a separately labeled near-singular threshold.
intent_signals: Show the reachable workspace of a robot arm.
Explain what happens to an arm at a singularity.
example_prompts: Build an arm with a reachable workspace volume and a singularity indicator.
Show the direction the end effector cannot move when the arm is fully stretched.
negative_signals: Not a dynamics or torque model: this recipe is kinematic only.
Not a certified safety envelope for any real robot.
not_for: Not a dynamics or torque model: this recipe is kinematic only.
Not a certified safety envelope for any real robot.

entities.name: Arm links
entities.guidance: Two rigid links of lengths 2 m and 1 m with parallel +z revolute axes and labeled full-turn angle ranges; self-contact is excluded from this kinematic model.

entities.name: Workspace shell
entities.guidance: Draw the exact reachable planar annulus of inner radius 1 m and outer radius 3 m, with a bounded polygon tessellation labeled display resolution.

entities.name: Singularity indicator
entities.guidance: At exact singular fixtures show the lost position direction; near-singular configurations show the weak singular-vector direction and a threshold label, not an exactly forbidden direction.

state_contract.model: Authored planar 2R arm with L1=2 m, L2=1 m, base at (0,0), parallel +z joint axes and independent full angular range [-pi,pi] with equivalent endpoints. Position task (x,y) only. FK: x=L1 cos(q1)+L2 cos(q1+q2), y=L1 sin(q1)+L2 sin(q1+q2). Velocity Jacobian rows are [-L1 sin(q1)-L2 sin(q1+q2), -L2 sin(q1+q2)] and [L1 cos(q1)+L2 cos(q1+q2), L2 cos(q1+q2)]. Exact reachable set is 1<=sqrt(x^2+y^2)<=3 m. Analytical IK: c2=(x^2+y^2-L1^2-L2^2)/(2 L1 L2), q2=+/-acos(c2), q1=atan2(y,x)-atan2(L2 sin(q2),L1+L2 cos(q2)); wrap angles and select the branch with smallest wrapped angular distance from the prior state, with positive q2 on a tie. Reject outside the annulus except for 1e-9 m boundary roundoff, which snaps to the nearest boundary before IK; clamp c2 only for corresponding roundoff. det(J)=L1 L2 sin(q2); exact straight/folded fixtures q2=0 or pi have rank one, otherwise rank two. Report sigma_min in m/rad and near-singular when sigma_min/(L1+L2)<0.01, an authored threshold distinct from exact rank loss. Nonfinite joint or target coordinates are rejected before geometric evaluation.
state_contract.authority: Joint angles determine FK and Jacobian. A requested target is independent input to the analytical annulus test and IK; acceptance updates joint angles once. The workspace is an exact planar annulus, not a sampled proof or a pose workspace.
actions: Drive joints individually or drag the end effector within the workspace.
Move to a stretched or aligned configuration and read the singularity indicator.
Toggle the reachable annulus and the joint-axis/angle labels.

invariants: Targets outside the supported annulus are refused, with the stated boundary-roundoff snap only; accepted targets reproduce their position through the selected analytical IK branch. No orientation target is promised.

At an exact singularity the arm loses at least one instantaneous task-space direction relative to its maximum achievable rank; an arm with fewer joints than task dimensions already lacks directions at regular configurations, so the scene reports the additional loss rather than an absolute count.

Rank is discrete, so the continuous indicator is the smallest singular value or a manipulability measure, which is displayed with its value and threshold. Its path need not be monotonic, and crossing the threshold is labelled near-singular rather than exact rank loss.
motion_guidance: Approach a singularity slowly and show the indicator degrading, since the interesting behaviour is the approach.
Never animate the end effector through a direction it cannot achieve; a smooth-looking cheat destroys the lesson.
known_limits: This authored 2R position-task annulus assumes full joint rotation, fixed link lengths and no obstacles or self-collision; narrower limits or another arm require a new membership model.
Kinematic singularity is not the same as a dynamic or control instability, which this recipe does not model.
A position workspace shell says nothing about achievable orientation at a point; if orientation is part of the task, the task dimension and the Jacobian convention must state so.
Authored guidance only: no scene runtime, rendering or numerical calibration has been run for this recipe.

claims.statement: A manipulator is at a kinematic singularity when the rank of its Jacobian falls below the maximum rank it can achieve, and at such a configuration the robot loses the ability to move in one or more directions.
claims.scope: Kinematic definition as cited; numerical rank determination requires a stated threshold.

source_refs.locator: 5.3 Singularities, rank definition and lost motion directions

object_craft.structure: Two links with joint housings, +z axis arrows, length marks and full-turn angle scales; no hard stops are drawn for the full-rotation model.
object_craft.material: Machined body material with a distinct joint housing treatment so axes are locatable from any angle.
object_craft.articulation: Each joint rotates about its declared axis within its limits; limits are enforced before any pose is displayed.

object_craft.structure: A translucent planar annulus with explicit inner and outer circles and an exact-set/display-tessellation caption.
object_craft.material: Low-opacity planar fill, opaque circular boundary strokes and a caption separating exact annulus radii from polygon display resolution.
object_craft.articulation: The fixed-length annulus stays unchanged while joint angles move; toggles affect only its visibility.

physical_contract.scope: Kinematic pose evaluation and workspace presentation; no torques, inertia or contact.
checks: Poses outside the workspace are refused with a stated reason.
At q2=0 or pi the analytical Jacobian loses one position direction. At small nonzero q2 the near-singular threshold may trigger while exact rank remains two; show the distinction.
